newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat falls with May in fast trading.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat falls with May in fast trading.

text.p: CBOT soft red winter wheat futures fell further near midday on fund and commercial selling with May in fast trading, traders said.
"Rand and Cargill are selling the July," a trader said.
The market was weakened early on follow through from the late break in the market Wednesday plus further evidence of strong competition for export business.

An European Union grain official said Thursday the EU remains a seller of wheat on the world market but volumes between now and the end of the season will depend strictly on bids at its weekly tender.
But the market was underpinned somewhat by USDA export data.
USDA Thursday said U.S. net export sales of wheat during the week ended March 6 totalled 355,400 tonnes, above expectations for 200,000 to 300,000 tonnes.
Nearby March was pressured by long liquidation. March will expire Wednesday and traders were getting out of that contract.
At 1140 CST, wheat was three to seven cents per bushel lower, with March down seven at $3.69 a bushel and May was down five at $3.74.
